what: ClawTeam is a free Python tool (MIT) that lets one AI agent run a team of other agents. You give a leader agent a goal. The leader runs `clawteam spawn` to start workers. Each worker gets its own git branch, its own tmux window and a shared task list. Workers message each other through file inboxes. A board shows progress. It works with Claude Code, Codex and other command-line agents. Its showcase is eight agents running 2,430 training experiments on eight H100 GPUs.

At run time the profile decides the attitude, then the work half does the task, and the output comes in that person's voice. Chief types `/slug` to call it.
